title: Car drives into moving commuter rail train in Concord
author: Peter Chianca
bullets: Local News No serious injuries were reported.
A driver in Concord accidentally hit the gas pedal at the worst possible time on Monday, driving directly into the side of a passing commuter rail train.

According to the MBTA Police, a woman in a 2019 Mazda was on Sudbury Street when she mistakenly hit the gas while at the railroad crossing between Grant and Thoreau streets, and drove into the side of a moving train.
